create.name: Shivananda Thomas Amelio
create.bio:
Shivananda Thomas Amelio is a teacher of yoga philosophy, mantra and meditation who was among the founding members of Kripalu, helping it grow from a small ashram into the large programme centre it is today. He spent close to twenty years with the community, including a year in India in 1990-91, where he received daily personal instruction from Swami Rajarshi Muni in the inner teachings of yoga and edited Rajarshi Muni's book Yoga: The Ultimate Spiritual Path. He later moved to New York City, worked on media projects with well-known authors in the wellness field, directed the Ross Institute's Center for Well-Being in East Hampton, and spent many years at the New York Open Center as faculty and then as its president and CEO, where he is now president emeritus.

His teaching rests on prana, breath and mantra within Patanjali's eightfold path. Since 2020 he has led a weekly Monday evening meditation class and sangha on Zoom, currently working through the Yoga Sutras, and each winter he returns to Kripalu to lead his New Year's Spiritual Renewal Retreat. He is also a certified professional coach who offers coaching and private spiritual mentoring by phone and video, and a musician and sound practitioner whose recordings include Mantra Darshan and The Infinite Om.

courses.title: New Year's Spiritual Renewal Retreat
courses.description: A residential New Year retreat at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, which Shivananda has led for many years. Through meditation, breathwork, mantra and self-inquiry, participants close the old year and build a daily practice grounded in the classical eight limbs of yoga.

courses.title: Prana, Breath & Mantra Meditation: Weekly Sangha
courses.description: A live class and community on Zoom most Monday evenings at 7pm Eastern, running since 2020. Each session combines breathwork, mantra and meditation with study of Patanjali's Yoga Sutras; students join by asking to be added to the weekly reminder list.

courses.title: Transformational Coaching and Spiritual Mentoring
courses.description: One-to-one work by phone or Zoom, usually three 45-minute sessions a month over three months, opening with a free exploratory call and a longer discovery session. Clients can also ask for private mentoring in meditation, mantra, yogic texts and building a personal practice.
